Kimi Code CLI: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Kimi Code CLI

No replay has run on Kimi Code CLI. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Kimi Code CLI.

What the Kimi Code CLI setup page says about coverage

Kimi decides which tools go through MCP. KYA gates the ones that do. A tool Kimi executes outside MCP is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the Kimi Code CLI recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
